memories.text: Request annual leave: submit it in the HR portal at least two weeks ahead, wait for your manager's approval, then add it to the team calendar.

steps: submit the request in the HR portal at least two weeks ahead
add the absence to the team calendar

memories.text: Employees get 25 days of annual leave.
Employees get 28 days of annual leave; up to 5 unused days carry over until 31 March.
Tell your manager before 9:30 on the first day you are sick; absences over three days need a doctor's note.
Onboard a new hire: order the laptop two weeks ahead, create the accounts, assign a buddy, and plan a first-day lunch.

steps: order the laptop two weeks ahead
plan the first-day lunch and a welcome meeting

memories.text: A new hire's laptop arrived late because it was ordered only the week before the start date.

fields.situation: a new colleague starts on Monday
fields.insight: equipment ordered one week ahead arrives late

memories.text: File a workplace incident report: make the area safe, tell the safety officer within 24 hours, fill in form S-12 and attach photos.

fields.trigger: an accident or near miss happens at work
steps: make the area safe and help anyone hurt
notify the safety officer within 24 hours

memories.text: Describe only observed facts in an incident report: no guesses about cause and no blame.
Take meeting minutes: note attendees, decisions and action items with owner and due date, and send them within 24 hours.

steps: record each action item with owner and due date

memories.text: Write action items in minutes as Owner, action, due date, one per line.
Book flights through the travel portal at least 14 days ahead and fly economy on flights under six hours.
Business class is allowed on flights over six hours with director approval.
memories.note: near-opposite of ad-flight by flight length

memories.text: The hotel limit is 140 EUR per night in cities and 100 EUR elsewhere.
Buy equipment over 1,000 EUR: collect three quotes, raise a purchase order, and get procurement approval before ordering.
Register visitors at reception the day before; visitors wear a visitor badge at all times and are never left alone.
Get IT help: open a ticket in the helpdesk portal; for outages call extension 4000.

steps: open a ticket in the helpdesk portal
describe the symptom and the device
for a total outage call extension 4000

memories.text: Change work passwords every 180 days, never share them, and keep them in the password manager.
A phishing email that imitated the CEO asked for gift cards; confirm any unusual payment request by phone.

fields.situation: an urgent email asks for money or credentials
fields.do_instead: confirm by phone with the person

memories.text: Open customer support replies with the customer's name, acknowledge the problem, and end with the next step and a date.
Process a refund: verify the order, check the 14-day return window, refund to the original payment method, and log the ticket.

fields.trigger: a customer asks for a refund
steps: refund to the original payment method

memories.text: Process a refund: verify the order, check the 30-day return window, refund to the original payment method, and log the ticket.

fields.trigger: a customer asks for a refund
steps: refund to the original payment method

memories.text: The office is closed on 24 and 31 December.
On remote days be reachable on chat from 9:30 to 16:00 and keep your calendar current.
On office days book a desk in the evening before.
Managers must complete the annual appraisals of their team by 15 December.
Write to external clients in a formal tone, state the requested action in the subject line, and sign with name and title.
Internal chat may be informal, but record decisions in the thread so they can be found later.
Use the corporate slide template and put the date and author in the footer of every deck.
At the September all-hands the company decided that from 2027 office days are Tuesday to Thursday.
Review the remote-work section of the staff handbook.
Send the draft appraisal forms to HR.
The north car park is closed until 31 October because of resurfacing.
Store all meeting minutes in the shared team drive.
Board meeting minutes are confidential and are stored only in the board folder, never in the shared team drive.
